compute_ask.flops_accounting: 6 * N * D with N the non-embedding parameter count (lower bound: attention and embedding FLOPs ignored)

full_grid_reference.description: 6 seeds x 4 optimizers x every harvested 1.2B ratio

compute_ask.peak_description: NVIDIA H100 SXM dense BF16 peak (989 TFLOP/s)

power_analysis.assumption: CROSS-STUDY SIGMA TRANSFER (stated assumption, not a measurement): the within-cell seed sd of a Fantastic Optimizers run (Llama-style architecture, marin codebase, OLMo-2-like data mixture) is taken to equal DataDecide's pooled within-cell seed sd (OLMo architecture, OLMo codebase, DataDecide mixtures) at the nearest scale. Nothing in the public artifacts measures the former. Sensitivity rows use x0.5 and x2
power_analysis.test: two-sided Welch t-test, alpha 0.05 (and Bonferroni 0.05/6 for the six optimizer pairs), power 0.8
power_analysis.unidentifiable_threshold: a gap is called unidentifiable when sigma / gap > 10 (more than ~1,500 seeds per arm at power 0.8)
power_analysis.units: DataDecide seed sd is measured on log2(C4-EN perplexity) = bits per token and multiplied by ln 2 to give nats per token; Fantastic Optimizers values are C4-EN validation cross-entropy in nats per token. All sigma, gap, and range values below are nats per token.
